description: Extract-over-Custom-SQL: a .hyper extract whose PRIMARY <connection> lists the [Extract].[Extract] placeholder relation first, with the real Custom SQL (type='text') as a sibling relation on the same connection. Before pickRootRelation the converter picked connRelations(conn)[0] = the placeholder and emitted a 0-column [Extract].[Extract] warehouse-table element (observed: .hyper extract over Custom SQL from TJ.PUBLIC.SUPERSTORE_ORDERS -> 0 elements/columns). Fix prefers the type='text' relation -> a kind:sql element with the query's columns. Targets TJ.PUBLIC.SUPERSTORE_ORDERS for portability.
